QC filtering for scRNA-seq Seurat objects

Bio_scRNA_qc_filter.Rd

Add mitochondrial (and optional ribosomal) percentage, optionally join layers, and filter cells by standard QC thresholds.

Usage

Bio_scRNA_qc_filter(
  object,
  mt_pattern = "^mt",
  calc_ribo = FALSE,
  ribo_pattern = "^Rpl|^Rps",
  min_features = 300,
  max_features = 4000,
  max_mt = 20,
  max_counts = 30000,
  join_layers = TRUE,
  return_counts = FALSE,
  assay = NULL,
  layer = "counts",
  slot = "counts"
)

Arguments

object

A Seurat object.

mt_pattern

Regex pattern for mitochondrial genes (default "^mt").

calc_ribo

Logical; compute percent.ribo if TRUE.

ribo_pattern

Regex pattern for ribosomal genes (default "^Rpl|^Rps").

min_features

Minimum nFeature_RNA (NULL to skip).

max_features

Maximum nFeature_RNA (NULL to skip).

max_mt

Maximum percent.mt (NULL to skip).

max_counts

Maximum nCount_RNA (NULL to skip).

join_layers

Logical; call JoinLayers if available (Seurat v5).

return_counts

Logical; return counts matrix in the result.

assay

Assay name to use (NULL uses DefaultAssay).

layer

Layer name for Seurat v5 (default "counts").

slot

Slot name for Seurat v4 (default "counts").

Value

If return_counts = FALSE, a filtered Seurat object. Otherwise, a list with elements: object and counts.
